manifest.name: dsh-gold-price
manifest.description: DSH web bundle: a draggable floating panel with live China gold quotes — SGE Au99.99, Au(T+D) and the 100g bar in CNY/gram, plus London spot for comparison; red-up/green-down change flashes, a session sparkline, auto refresh and a remembered position.
manifest.author: eastbadman

bundle.text:
- insert:
    - id: gold-price
      name: dsh-gold-price
      config: {}

readme.text:
[English](#english) | 中文

一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）插件：在 dsh 页面里加一个**可拖动的悬浮窗**，实时显示国内黄金行情。

- **沪金99.99**（SGE Au99.99 现货）、**黄金延期**（Au T+D）、**金条100g** —— 元/克，涨跌按昨日结算价计算
- **伦敦金现**对照 —— 美元/盎司
- **红涨绿跌**（国内行情惯例），价格每次变动红/绿闪烁提示
- 沪金99.99 **近 30 分钟走势线**（页面打开期间累积）
- 20 秒自动刷新（页面隐藏时暂停，回到前台立即刷新）
- 按住标题栏**拖动**，位置自动记忆（`localStorage`），可折叠成小条

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-gold-price
```

或从 GitHub 安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/eastbadman/dsh-gold-price
```

安装后无需重启（HMR 生效）；若未出现，刷新一次页面。

新浪行情接口要求新浪域 Referer 且不发送 CORS 头，浏览器直连不可行，因此：

- **Host 半**（Node）按需抓取 `hq.sinajs.cn` 公开行情（带 Referer，15 秒缓存，无人在看时零后台请求），通过 `webServer.register()` 暴露**同源**路由 `/gold-price/ticker.json`
- **Client 半**注册到 `shell.overlay` 插槽渲染悬浮窗，同源轮询，不产生任何跨域请求；样式全部使用 dsh 宿主主题 token
行情来自新浪财经公开接口（上海黄金交易所 / 伦敦金现）。数据仅供参考，不构成任何投资建议；接口若调整，面板会显示获取失败并保留最后缓存。休市期间显示最后收盘价并标注行情时间。
A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) plugin: a **draggable floating panel** inside the dsh page with live China gold quotes.

- **SGE Au99.99**, **Au(T+D)** and the **100g bar** in CNY/gram (change vs. previous settlement)
- **London spot** comparison in USD/oz
- Red-up / green-down flashes on every move (CN market convention)
- A ~30-minute sparkline of Au99.99 (accumulated while the page is open)
- 20s auto refresh (pauses while the tab is hidden)
- Drag by the header; position remembered in `localStorage`; collapsible

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-gold-price
```

The Sina quote endpoint requires a sina-domain Referer and sends no CORS headers, so the Host half fetches it from Node (15s cache, no background traffic when nobody is watching) and serves it through a **same-origin** `webServer` route; the Client half renders in the `shell.overlay` slot and never makes a cross-origin request. All styling uses host theme tokens.

Quotes come from Sina Finance's public endpoint (SGE / London spot). Indicative only — not investment advice.
